# The compose PDF regression test waits for the external-helper dialog

The test configures PDF always-ask/helper handling, adds and selects one PDF attachment, arms the unknownContentType dialog promise before OpenSelectedAttachment, and awaits the cancelled dialog. The checked compose fallback creates a system-principal channel and passes it to URILoader; internal PDF tab handling is a separate configured branch. This is static comm test/caller evidence, not proof of the separate upstream PDF.js guard, rendered PDF behavior or a passing native test.

Scope: Compose attachment-opening test contract.
